principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling multiple responsibilities: managing items, quantities, prices and maintaining the order status.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the Order class into smaller classes, such as `Product` to handle `items`, `quantities`, and `prices`, and `OrderStatus` to handle the status.

principle_violations.reason: The Order class allows direct modification of item details, which may lead to changes in multiple areas if new item attributes need to be added.
principle_violations.suggestion: Create a separate `Item` class that holds item-related details. This will make it easier to extend functionalities without modifying the Order class.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
